hpi: Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS) is an acute inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy characterized by rapid onset of muscle weakness and areflexia. It is often preceded by an infection. Diagnosis is primarily clinical, but can be supported by lumbar puncture showing albuminocytologic dissociation. Treatment includes supportive care and may involve IVIG or plasmapheresis.
